authority.rule: Drive owns engineering/evidence content. Git mirrors the staged proof contract.

purpose: Prove a representative current-technology physical basis before dense 4D integration. The ladder samples fundamental functions; it does not physically qualify all 407 archetypes.
progression_rule: Each stage is independently gated. Failure or unknown at one stage cannot be bypassed by a later integrated article.

stages.name: Passive .cgx identity and provenance
stages.article: Benign substrate with passive optical identity marker; no energized function required.
stages.hard_gate: Stop on identity, hash, source, revision or provenance mismatch.

stages.name: Conductor and interconnect geometry
stages.article: Printed trace / vertical interconnect / reference or ground region coupon.
stages.hard_gate: Benign low-voltage measurement only; no current/power claim beyond the tested envelope.

stages.name: Printed passive R/C/L basis
stages.article: Separate resistor, capacitor and air-core/planar inductor coupons before any dense co-print.
stages.hard_gate: Passives remain separate evidence objects; one passing passive cannot qualify the others.

stages.name: Resonator and antenna / field geometry
stages.article: LC resonator and loop/NFC geometry with conventional comparator and bounded alternative geometry.
stages.hard_gate: No biological/natural-frequency claim; measured RF/EM exposure and regulatory limits remain separate.

stages.name: Simple sensing
stages.article: Thermocouple and/or conductivity sensor coupon using exact process/material calibration.
stages.hard_gate: Sensor output is not a calibrated physical quantity until referenced against an appropriate standard.

stages.name: Low-voltage electromagnetic actuation
stages.article: Low-energy solenoid/coil-plunger or comparable actuator coupon.
stages.hard_gate: Low-voltage benign fixture only; no pressure valve, mains switching or safety actuator substitution.

stages.name: Hybrid seed-component embedding
stages.article: Visible LED seed integrated into printed conductors/thermal/identity structure.
measure: I-V-L or optical output as instrumented
stages.hard_gate: LED remains a seed component; successful embedding does not establish local semiconductor-die fabrication.

stages.name: Measured ambient-energy handling and storage bus
stages.article: Ambient RF collector/rectifier/storage/load coupon using measured incident spectrum and explicit loss accounting.
stages.hard_gate: Energy conservation is non-negotiable; no free-energy, void-energy or unmeasured ambient-source claim.

stages.name: Eco-Grex recovered-feed material coupon
stages.article: Low-risk article made only after provenance, cleaning, contamination/chemistry assay, formulation and reference coupon.
measure: mechanical/thermal/electrical property required by intended use
stages.hard_gate: Recovered feed is not upgraded to graphene or another high-spec material without validated conversion and characterization.

stages.name: Multilayer functional surface
stages.article: Protective base + optional functional layer + environmental topcoat, with explicit interface/new-neutral layers.
stages.hard_gate: No safety-critical control or unmeasured biofeedback/resonance claim.

stages.name: Dense micro↔macro 4D integrated body
stages.article: Integrated volumetric assembly using already qualified lower-stage functions, explicit interfaces, build order and service boundaries.
measure: full field/state readback appropriate to the article
stages.hard_gate: Integration cannot raise the evidence ceiling of any child component; unresolved pairwise interactions block higher-order novelty claims.

raphael_rule: For any candidate geometry: conventional baseline → bounded candidate set → standard physics solve → Raphael residual/comparison → hard gates/Pareto → matched physical test → DBR.
next_digital_population: Instantiate P0 SH01-ID-A from its exact existing plan/source records.
Select and bind exact low-consequence materials/processes for P1 trace/interconnect.
Select exact P2 resistor/capacitor/inductor coupon geometries and test instruments without inventing performance targets.
Generate P3 resonator/loop conventional-vs-candidate geometry packets only after material/process/tool resolution.
